name: Progress
description: How far a task has got.

props.name: value
props.description: How far along it is. Leave it out for a task with no measurable end — the bar sweeps and reports nothing.

props.name: min
props.description: The bottom of the range. Default `0`.

props.name: max
props.description: The top of the range, and so what "full" means. Default `100`.

props.name: label
props.description: What the bar is called. A progress bar has to be named — nothing about it is readable otherwise.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: The same, naming an element that already says it.

props.name: format
props.description: The value as it should be read out: "3 of 10 files", "eleven minutes left".

a11y: `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and, when there is one, `aria-valuenow`.
`label` or `labelledBy` is what names it. A bar with neither is a percentage nobody can attach to anything.
`format` writes `aria-valuetext`, for a value the number alone does not read as.
